description: Runs a LightSpot SEO and AI-visibility audit on a URL, waits for it to finish, and returns a summary (score, top actions, main issues). Ideal for "audit this site and tell me what to fix". Can take 1 to 3 minutes; past the time limit, it returns the id so you can follow up with get_audit_status / get_audit.

maxPages.description: Number of pages to crawl (capped by your plan).

url.description: URL to audit (home page or a specific page).

name: audit_and_wait
title: Audit a URL and wait for the result
